source_review: Reviewed all ten changed files and actual control/notification/provider call paths; source is pinned and clean.

The authenticated bounded webhook dispatcher selects only launcher callbacks; authority comes from callback_query.from and private chat, with strict accessible message date. Handles contain random public routing data, not credentials or authority.

Handle ownership includes user/chat/project/operation/instance/attempt generation/action and 24-hour expiry. Current read/start grants are reloaded across I/O; duplicate Start uses the existing operation lock and engine idempotency.

Status uses explicit bounded fields from actual engine records. Raw results, prompts, feedback, private paths and queue payloads are omitted. Typed check/artifact/PR claims remain labelled agent-reported and tied to accepted result commit; graph DONE is not test PASS.

HTTPS origin accepts operator configuration only, rejects private/noncanonical IP, local suffix/trailing-dot, credential, query, fragment and path forms. Public link has only the opaque handle; gateway authentication is not implemented or approved here.

SQLite triggers freeze safe owner/lifecycle/instance intent in the operation transaction. Indexed one-time backfill and migration marker commit together; rollback preserves retryability without duplicating history.

Notice claim/finish use persisted leases, at most five attempts and static errors; wrong/stale lease cannot finish a replacement claim. Delivery requires current read and actual scoped Telegram ACK, survives retired slots, never activates, and honestly allows duplicate physical messages after lost ACK.
Independent single-flight launcher and notification batches retain gather-all failure isolation and actual thread quiescence before resource teardown.

decision_request.feedback: APPROVE exact 2f59b53c2ba765f12079f8000e0ba60f90c9d469 for Telegram controls/outbox stage only. Twenty-three focused independent checks passed: 9 controls, 13 migration/lifecycle/background regressions and 1 supplemental disclosure/owner probe. Verified webhook-gated callback_query.from private identity, opaque owner/project/operation/instance/generation/action/expiry binding, current Start/read checks, idempotent Start, read-only engine projection, typed agent-labelled reports without raw-summary fallback, canonical public HTTPS validation, atomic safe lifecycle intents, one-time rollback-safe indexed backfill, lease fencing and bounded at-least-once retry. Another read/start-authorized owner cannot use the handle; read revocation immediately before callback/notifier send prevents disclosure and does not activate work. Both background transports preserve normal ticks and actual shutdown quiescence. Early legacy-loopback/trailing-dot origin finding is fixed. Signed initData/session/CSRF gateway is explicitly next stage; real Bot/mobile/external-model delivery remains unverified.
